newsitem.title: USA: Exco Resources to take $290,000 Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Exco Resources to take $290,000 Q1 charge.

text.p: Exco Resources Inc said Wednesday it will take a $290,000 charge to its first quarter because Coda Energy Inc terminated an agreement under which Exco would buy Coda's Taurus Energy Corp unit for $35 million in cash and $10 million in Exco common stock.
Exco said the charge would cover the cost of the proposed acquisition -- announced August 14 -- and related financing activities.
Exco is a Dallas-based oil and gas explorer.
An Exco spokesman said the deal's "underwriting fell through" before the deal's expiration date.
He said the company would now spend between $5 million and $10 million on acquisitions for the quarter, although would spend more if an ideal acquisition came along.
He declined to name specific companies.
